title: The Book Collection Hall
summary: Inside the Book Collection Hall, the top five may each take one reward from the energy barriers before the flames on a rune go out. Xiao Yan grabs the Di Class Nine Layer Phoenix Flame Skill and gives it to Xun Er, who needs it for her advancement. He uses Soul Perception to hunt for a Sonic Dou Skill and finds a sonic wave just as time runs out. Xun Er helps him pull it out at the last moment, and it is the Lion Tiger Gold Shattering Roar. A hall elder tells him he has grasped only its first stage, 30 to 40 percent of its power. Vice Dean Hu Qian then leads the five through the dangerous mountains behind the academy to Elder Zhao and Elder Lu of the Inner Academy. Elder Zhao gives each a crystal card and starts the Fire Energy Hunting Competition, where seniors hunt the newcomers for the Fire Energy in their cards.
events: A voice explains the hall's rules: one item each, taken only from the energy layer, within the time limit.
Rewards appear, including the Xuan Class Purple Lightning Burst and a Rank Six Magical Beast Core.
Xiao Yan takes the Nine Layer Phoenix Flame Skill (Di Class Middle Rank) and gives it to Xun Er.
Xiao Yan senses a sonic wave with Soul Perception; with Xun Er's help he retrieves the Lion Tiger Gold Shattering Roar.
He practises it in the hall and learns its first stage.
Hu Qian advises the five to put aside their quarrels and leads them to the Inner Academy.
Elder Zhao and Elder Lu meet them and announce the Fire Energy Hunting Competition.
